records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Collective
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, no first project or key milestone despite three nudges (email:0e3e8a8a, email:5cf33869, email:249f0d1b). Customer reply was positive but non-committal with no stated plan (email:e07be13a). One invite sent shows mild intent; 8 days remain, so some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for the reply -- glad things are going well so far, and good to hear your teammate is on board.

Whenever you're ready for the next step, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project and adding a few tasks is usually the quickest way to see Wrenfield in action. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set that first project up with you.

Best,
Chidi
